'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Matt Thornton DS My Lord, Is That Legal''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Thornton]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
